semantic_html.reasoning: Good semantic structure but form inputs lack associated label elements

navigation_structure.reasoning: Clear primary navigation but uses javascript:void(0) links that block agents

form_clarity.reasoning: Search form is clear but cart forms have hidden fields without labels

authentication.reasoning: OpenID Connect flow required for all transactional actions — complex for agents

captcha_presence.reasoning: No CAPTCHA detected on any crawled pages — major advantage for agents

dynamic_content.reasoning: Heavy JavaScript dependency on all pages — content loads dynamically after render

action_discoverability.reasoning: Primary actions are findable but buried in complex navigation structure

error_handling.reasoning: Some error signals present but not consistently structured for agent detection

api_parity.reasoning: No public browsing API — all actions require UI interaction

existing_agent_support.reasoning: No robots.txt agent directives, no MCP support, no agents.json found

summary: Amazon India presents moderate agent compatibility. Guest browsing and search work well but cart operations and checkout require OpenID authentication. Heavy JavaScript dependency limits autonomous operation.
